name: BLUE NILE Ethiopian market and restaurant
notes: All 3 photos are legible menu pages. Photos 1 and 2 are two revisions of the same Lunch/Dinner page with overlapping items at different prices (e.g. Ye-Shiro Wot $12.99 vs $10.99); used photo 1's prices and added Kitfo (only in photo 2). Photo 3 is signed 'Abay Ethiopian Market and Restaurant' at the same address (Abay is Amharic for Blue Nile, so likely the prior name of this same place) with a 2023 receipt taped alongside; merged its breakfast section and additional entrees not present in photos 1/2.
